review.imagery: Fifteen distinct phase-specific project renders were visually reviewed. The original brochure development aerial supplies the listing and developer-hero card cover. Five current-gallery amenity images and nine additional native brochure views cover frontage, tower details, setting, two living-room angles, bedrooms and lobby. Duplicate gallery/brochure scenes, green backgrounds, generic landscape and stock people are excluded. Proposed surroundings remain source design context. No dated construction photographs or card badges.
review.floorPlans: Eight original home layouts retain their position keys and notices. Numerical unit areas are not printed. Convertible labels describe proposed adaptability. They do not confirm an approved extra bedroom. Request the contractual unit size and approved configuration from SAMANA. All eight complete physical plan-pack pages 4–11 were individually reviewed. They distinguish two one-bedroom, two one-bedroom-with-study, three two-bedroom and one two-bedroom-with-study drawings. Brochure pages 20–23 repeat the same layouts on paired spreads and add no unique sheet. The primary FAQ’s 443 sq ft starting figure has no verified type or area basis and is not assigned to these drawings.
review.location: The original physical brochure map spread on page 4 was visually reviewed, including all 12 destination groups. The official map q coordinate 25.14685828894434, 55.40255717449963 is recorded with source hash and six-place conversion. The primary FAQ’s different Mall of the Emirates/Dubai Marina estimates and additional DXB range remain explicit. The map pin is project vicinity and the Blue Line remains proposed connectivity.
review.provenance: Fresh official HTML, original developer brochure and official microsite floor-plan/fact PDFs retain retrieval receipts, bytes and SHA-256 values. Native image URLs, complete source sheets and individual physical-page links remain available. Protected identity, completed text/commercial research and source discrepancies are unchanged.
review.cardSelection: 8 November 2026: the proposed development setting (samana-greenfield-2-aerial) now supplies the listing and developer-hero card cover, superseding the original cover selection. The development aerial replaces the near-identical twin-block frontage used for Greenfield; proposed surroundings remain source design context. Own source: https://www.samanadevelopers.com/storage/projects-files/2026/08/18/01/56/8ccf8c9cde3cd2954a7415686541b8f5.pdf#page=11. Only the card selection changes; original gallery assets, source attribution and image-scope qualifications remain unchanged.

unavailable: Numerical drawing-specific unit areas, contractual convertible-layout approval, a verified visitor entrance and dated construction photographs were not established. Published travel-source differences remain qualified.
